Billing questions

The practical details

How do I pay?

From inside the app, using eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay. You can pay monthly or yearly, and the yearly price is ten months — two months free.

What happens after the 30-day trial?

Nothing is deleted. If you do not upgrade, the account drops back to the Free plan automatically and your data stays exactly where it is.

Can I change plans later?

Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately and the difference is adjusted against your next payment.

Do you offer refunds?

Subscriptions are billed for a period already in use, so we do not refund part of a month. If something has gone wrong with a charge, write to us and we will sort it out. See the refund section of our terms for detail.

Not sure which plan fits?

Tell us how many counters and staff you have. We will tell you honestly.
